title: Invoice attachment
passage:
Could you attach the invoice to your reply?
A. Certainly, I will send the PDF.
B. It was issued on Friday.
C. I'll update the delivery address.
passageZh:
你可以回信時附上發票嗎？
A. 當然，我會寄出 PDF 檔。
B. 那張發票是星期五開立的。
C. 我會更新送貨地址。
